name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=ai, descriptor=score_physical_attack). Accurately reflects purpose (enemy AI scores physical-attack candidates and records the best). No Ghidra address residue, no domain-ID stripping needed.
purpose: Enemy AI: evaluate every reachable tile for a physical attack with the caster's equipped weapon and record the single best candidate (target tile x/y, target runtime_char index, score class) into the ai_best_physical_* result globals.
logic_summary: Init best tiebreak=0, ai_best_physical_score=0. Read attacker AP/DP. Find equipped weapon (kind 0); if none, return 0. Read weapon AoE shape (x@+0xB, y@+0xC). Movement class = 0x13 when status-immunity predicate holds for caster, else job byte @+0x20. Get move-cost table; malloc pAlloc_a(0x20, allocated/freed but content unused), pTile_pos_buf(0x800). ctx_flag==0 -> use_smaller_aoe=1. Paint threat overlay, flood-fill movement range, mark friendly-occupant tiles, collect unmarked reachable tiles -> n_reachable, re-obfuscate tile map. malloc pTarget_id_buf(100). For each reachable candidate tile: effective AP/DP = base + (terrain_mv/def_modifier[tile_id] * stat)/100, applied only when status-immunity predicate holds (tile_id = tile_buf[5] from fd2_read_tile_attribute_at_pos). Compute AoE targets at candidate; re-obfuscate. For each AoE target: target AP/DP with same terrain adjustment; raw_dmg = effective_AP - target_DP; score_class = 0 if raw_dmg<=2 else 8; if raw_dmg > target.HP_current -> raw_dmg*=2, score_class=0x12 (kill). If target can default-attack back (==1) -> raw_dmg += effective_DP - target_AP (counter bonus). If target.char_id==0 (party leader) -> raw_dmg = raw_dmg*3/2. Keep candidate when score_class > best, or (== best && raw_dmg > tiebreak): store cand_x/cand_y/target_idx/score_class and tiebreak. Free 3 buffers, return 0.

comment_original_issue: Original src comment block (4 lines) was accurate but minimal: it stated only 'score every reachable tile / write best to ai_best_physical_* / return 0' without the load-bearing scoring semantics (priority classes 0/8/0x12, terrain-bonus gating via the status-immunity predicate, kill/counter/leader bonuses, the equipped-weapon AoE setup, ctx_flag role, or the pairing with fd2_execute_ai_physical_attack). A reader of src alone could not follow the algorithm.
